name: deependhq-site
description: deependhq.com. Static assets plus a Cloudflare Worker. Published by scripts/publish.sh.

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-shells.mjs && node scripts/build-data.mjs && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/build-islands.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/guard.mjs && node scripts/brand-guard.mjs && node scripts/build-data.mjs && node scripts/link-check.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/guard-selftest.mjs && node scripts/ingest-selftest.mjs && node scripts/p3-selftest.mjs && node scripts/p4-selftest.mjs

//dependencies: esbuild is a BUILD dependency, not a dev one. Cloudflare builds can install with NODE_ENV=production, which skips devDependencies and leaves prerender with no bundler, so the pages would publish with an empty #root. react and react-dom are RUNTIME dependencies: scripts/build-islands.mjs bundles them into home-islands.js for the browser islands. playwright-core and wrangler stay dev: they are only used by hand.
